## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Undoes the effect of [Disable Nameplates](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/disable%2Bnameplates) for one or more Viewed Players from the perspective of one or more Viewing Players.

## Snippet

```
Enable Nameplates(Event Player, All Players(All Teams));
```

## Properties

**Returns**: _<span style="color: #c678dd">Void</span>_
**Parameters**: ==_Viewed Players_==, ==_Viewing Players_==

> ==**Viewed Players**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[Event Player](/wiki/articles/event+player)**_
> The Player or Players who will have their Nameplates enabled.

> ==**Viewing Players**==
> _Type: **[Player](/wiki/articles/player)** | **Array** (**Player**), Default: **[All Players](/wiki/articles/all+players)**_
> The Viewing Player or Players for whom the viewed Player's nameplate will be enabled.
````
